correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, 2<=k<n and ceil(n/k)<=t<n, the median-flow lower bound follows from edgewise integer conservation. The median gives a zero-flow cut and an optimal order-preserving line matching. Coordinatewise maxima preserve the positive upper-bounded cyclic gaps, and an explicit tight-gap dependency lemma proves a unit-step path of exactly the line-matching cost whenever t<n<kt. At kt=n all t gaps equal k and every one of the k distinct phases is frozen. Separate Python and C++ exhaustive all-pairs verification over every k,t through n=10 and n=12, respectively, and independent constructive routes for 12,488 cases through n=100 corroborate the argument. No computation substitutes for its infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact shortest dynamic protection relocation cost for every fixed-size cyclic k-path cover is a natural optimization objective. The 2019/2022 direct predecessor only decided reachability and gave non-shortest cycle sequences. The linear-time median expression and its sharp frozen boundary solve a different quantitative problem for all orders, path lengths and feasible token levels; the isometric embedding is structural and potentially reusable.
